clare: tiny thread: thinking through breadcrumb truncation when we push more nested routes. Problem: breadcrumbs overflow the topbar on small widths. Options: ellide middle segments, use popover on overflow, or show compact dot / tooltip. Thoughts?

henry: prefer ellide middle segments with popover showing full path. Keeps main crumb stable while letting power users access full path.

mina: a11y: ensure popover is keyboard accessible and focus-trapped while open. Also, if we ellide, provide an accessible label that includes the hidden segments.

pat: telemetry: if we show ellided crumb, still send full route in page_view event. Don't let UI truncation affect analytics.

clare: cool. will mock ellide + tooltip + sr-only full path. Will add to PR.
